Descriptions.DefaultFallback: This software is classified by computer repair technicians as a Potentially Unwanted Program (PUP) that commonly injects background processes, modifies browser configurations, displays false error alerts, or degrades computer responsiveness.
Descriptions.onelaunch: OneLaunch docks a persistent top-screen search bar, silently replaces your default browser, redirects search traffic, and consumes continuous background CPU resources.
Descriptions.wavebrowser: Wave Browser is a repackaged Chromium browser known to bundle intrusive search modifiers, hijack default file associations, and push unauthorized desktop popups.
Descriptions.waveserver: Wave Server is the persistence service for Wave Browser that automatically relaunches the rogue browser if closed.
Descriptions.driverone: DriverOne is an unverified utility known to flag phantom driver errors and demand recurring credit card payments to 'fix' non-existent problems.
Descriptions.driverfix: DriverFix is an aggressive driver updater known to replace stable manufacturer drivers with untested packages that cause blue screens (BSODs).
Descriptions.driverupdate: DriverUpdate displays misleading hardware alerts to sell recurring subscriptions; Windows Update already provides certified WHQL drivers for free.
Descriptions.driversupport: DriverSupport runs background scans that generate urgent warning banners to promote paid subscription plans.
Descriptions.drivereasy: Driver Easy is a third-party driver utility often bundled with trialware; Windows Update already provides certified, stable drivers for free.
Descriptions.driverdoc: DriverDoc flags common device drivers as 'critically outdated' to entice users into paying for unverified driver downloads.
Descriptions.driverreviver: Driver Reviver displays exaggerated driver error reports to sell software licenses; manual driver updates are rarely needed in modern Windows.
Descriptions.drivergenius: Driver Genius installs background update services that frequently conflict with Windows Update driver delivery.
Descriptions.smartdrivercare: Smart Driver Care uses fear-based popups claiming system hardware failure unless a paid activation key is entered.
Descriptions.auslogicsdriverupdater: Auslogics Driver Updater bundles promotional trialware and frequently prompts users with misleading driver severity ratings.
Descriptions.pcdirector: PCDirector is an unverified utility that installs background telemetry and displays recurring purchase prompts.
Descriptions.segurazo: Segurazo / Santivirus deeply hooks into Windows system services, resists standard uninstallation, and severely slows system responsiveness.
Descriptions.santivirus: Santivirus (Segurazo) acts as a rogue pseudo-antivirus that disables legitimate security features and blocks removal.
Descriptions.webdiscover: Web Discover installs a persistent browser toolbar and search box that tracks web browsing history and injects advertisements.
Descriptions.bytefence: ByteFence is an unrequested software bundle that changes default search engines to Yahoo/Bing affiliate feeds and resists removal.
Descriptions.restoro: Restoro is an aggressive PC optimizer tool that flags fabricated registry errors and displays urgent payment countdown timers.
Descriptions.pcacceleratesetup: PC Accelerate displays false alerts claiming severe system corruption to sell high-priced software subscriptions.
Descriptions.outbyte: Outbyte PC Repair displays exaggerated hardware warnings and high-pressure subscription prompts for standard maintenance tasks.
Descriptions.mypcbackup: MyPCBackup continuously displays intrusive system tray popups claiming personal files are at risk unless a paid cloud account is purchased.
Descriptions.slimcleaner: SlimCleaner installs background telemetry monitors and promotes unnecessary system optimization subscriptions.
Descriptions.reimage: Reimage Repair uses scareware popups and website redirects claiming severe virus infection to sell phone repair services.
Descriptions.driverbooster: Driver Booster frequently installs aggressive upsell popups and third-party driver packages that can destabilize hardware.
Descriptions.iobituninstaller: IObit Uninstaller injects background promotional notifications, installs bundled utilities, and runs persistence services.
Descriptions.advancedsystemcare: Advanced SystemCare aggressively modifies registry keys, bundles browser toolbars, and introduces background telemetry services.
Descriptions.pcoptimizerpro: PC Optimizer Pro is a legacy rogue cleaner that reports hundreds of fabricated issues to coerce payment.
Descriptions.cleanmypc: CleanMyPC advertises registry cleaning features that Microsoft warns can corrupt Windows system hives.
Descriptions.webcompanion: Lavasoft Web Companion overrides browser homepages and search providers to inject targeted advertising.
Descriptions.premieropinion: PremierOpinion is a background market research tracker that logs browsing habits and consumes network bandwidth.
Descriptions.relevantknowledge: RelevantKnowledge is a background data-mining utility that intercepts web traffic and transmits demographic telemetry.
Descriptions.speedupmypc: SpeedUpMyPC uses deceptive scanning animations to convince users their PC is damaged so they purchase paid cleanup software.
Descriptions.regcleanpro: RegClean Pro displays fabricated registry danger warnings; modern Windows does not require commercial registry cleaners.
Descriptions.weatherzero: WeatherZero is an adware package disguised as a desktop weather gadget that injects web ads and tracking scripts.
Descriptions.pcappstore: PC App Store (pcapp.store) is an aggressive software bundler that displays full-screen intrusive overlays, injects unrequested desktop widgets, and installs unwanted background software.
Descriptions.pcapp: PC App Store installer component known for aggressive full-screen promotional overlays and bundled utilities.
Descriptions.sparkpc: Spark PC is an alias for the PC App Store distribution network that injects unrequested desktop toolbars and adware.
